_comment: Format of <main checkout>/.local/deploy/config.json for tools/release/release.ps1 (docs/chromite/release-harness.md). Copy it there and fill in the values; never commit the filled file (the repository is public). No secrets: the key is passed by path only and never read.

production.hostKeyFingerprint: SHA256:<fingerprint of the pinned host key>

neighbor._comment: The other service on the same server. Checked before and after a production deploy; any difference stops the harness.
neighbor.feed: <https URL of the other service's download feed (JSON with a files list)>

rehearsal.host: <ssh alias of a Linux host with Docker>
